text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was able to deliver the absolute best 
run I'm capable of right now! That passion 
reached Ardan-senpai, and she told me 
she's going to keep walking toward her 
"dream" too, su!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And my next goal is the Yasuda Kinen, the 
race that decides the king of miles for 
the first half of the year! I'm gonna 
prove I can be the absolute best Umamusume 
in mile races too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Chiyono O working super 
hard toward her comeback! Seeing how 
serious she was really fired me up, too—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Chiyono O...! I can't wait 
to see you run again...!
